question: What security and product boundary should govern live log-tail and command-output widgets in the bundled modular dashboard?
rationale: The feature is useful for operator visibility, but command output and log tails can contain sensitive data, and the referenced dashboard widget/binding substrate is not accepted on main yet.

options.title: Defer until substrate and binding design land
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical widget request, but implement only after the dashboard substrate and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101150 have a reviewed stream/command security model.

options.title: Split log tail from command output
options.body: Allow a first pass that wraps the existing `logs.tail` API as a read-only widget, while keeping command-output widgets blocked on a separate command-execution and redaction review.

options.title: Keep outside bundled dashboard
options.body: Ask for this as an external plugin or ClawHub package unless maintainers decide these widgets are first-party dashboard content.

recommendation.title: Defer until substrate and binding design land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical widget request, but implement only after the dashboard substrate and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101150 have a reviewed stream/command security model.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the clearest current-main history on the Control UI plugin-tab seam and existing log-tail surfaces that bound the decision.
